thread:
mira patel: hey team! first week question — my M2 MacBook enrolled yesterday but I'm blocked from installing VirtualBox for a client sandbox. Installer fails with 'system extension blocked'. FileVault is enabled.

mira patel: screenshot says "System Extension Blocked" and points to Security & Privacy > General. Can't click approve (button greyed out).

jamie-it: welcome, Mira. We usually don't give permanent admin. Two paths: we can push a vetted VirtualBox payload via Kandji, or schedule a short remote session and apply a scoped exception for the vendor cert.

mira patel: can you check my device state? serial is C02DEF98765X

device-bot: [automated] Device C02DEF98765X - enrolled: yes; FileVault: enabled; restrictions: com.redwood.restrict-kext = true; admin: standard user.

sam eng: FWIW VirtualBox on Apple silicon is tricky — often better to use vendor-specific arm VMs or run linux containers. But understood some client tooling requires it.

jamie-it: easiest is a 20m session today. we'll temporarily allow the vendor cert SHA and run the installer. No permanent admin, and we'll revert policy after. Mira, what time works?

mira patel: 2:00pm PT works. thanks all. I'll DM the serial and link.

jamie-it: added a KB ticket for onboarding-Virtualization feat. After the session we'll add the exact cert fingerprint and steps to the docs so new hires can avoid extra hops.

mira patel: Installer completed, clicked Allow in Security prefs after jamie pushed the cert. rebooted, VirtualBox launches. leaving this note here in case others hit it.

jamie-it: confirmed device shows exception applied then removed. closing out. :thumbsup:
